## Overview

The Order of the Raven is the church of **The Raven Queen**  -  deity of death and the grave, presiding over life's end. Its clergy serve as guardians of death rites, memory-keepers, and destroyers of undeath.

## Structure

The Order is solemn and ritualistic. Its clergy tend the dying, guard graveyards, and perform funeral rites that ensure souls pass peacefully to the afterlife. The Order despises undeath in all forms and actively works to destroy undead creatures.

## Membership

- **Death Priests**: Clerics who perform funeral rites and guide souls to the afterlife
- **Grave Wardens**: Guardians of cemeteries and memorial sites
- **Undead Hunters**: Paladins and warriors who destroy undead creatures
- **Memory-Keepers**: Archivists who preserve the names and stories of the dead
- **Shadow Elves (Shadar-kai)**: The Raven Queen's primary worshippers, who serve as her agents

## Goals

- Ensure the dead are properly honored and laid to rest
- Destroy undeath in all its forms
- Preserve the memories of those who have passed
- Guard the boundary between life and death

## Headquarters

The Order has no public main temple. Its primary sanctuary is a hidden cathedral in the threshold spaces between cities — accessible only to those who know the paths. Shadow Elf communities maintain their own shrines dedicated to the Raven Queen in hidden locations throughout the recovered territories.
